Days after Cyclone Arnab hit the coasts of Andhra Pradesh, a new cyclone has formed in the Bay Of Bengal.
The India Meteorological Department has announced that 'Cyclonic Storm Murasu', meaning war drum, has intensified over the Bay of Bengal. The premier met agency warned that it could intensify into a very severe cyclonic storm, with wind speeds of 100 to 110 kilometres per hour and gusts reaching 120 kilometres per hour.
According to the India Meteorological Department, the cyclone is likely to make landfall along the Andhra Pradesh coast on November 3.
